svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut 240 x 240 mm from 3 mm aluminium sheet; round the corners.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Centre hole 152 mm for the fan's inlet: drill a ring of holes inside

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the line, cut out, file to the line (or use a 152 mm hole saw).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fan screws: four 4.4 mm holes on an 80 mm radius at 45 degrees,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: countersunk from the front; match them to the fan you buy.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Wall screws: four 4.4 mm holes 105 mm each side of centre at the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Grille screws: four holes tapped M4 (drill 3.3) 110 mm from centre

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: on the centre lines, top, bottom, left and right.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: fan body flat on the back of the plate; plate flat on the wall

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: over the 200 mm sleeve; grille over the plate.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the fan screws pull the fan face flat onto the plate.
